purpose_context: Felix sub-agents non-deterministically pick the unpaired exec host=node, which errors and triggers a false-positive WhatsApp cron-failure alert even though the run self-recovers. This mission adds an explicit AGENTS.md directive across the Felix sub-agents to always use host=gateway, eliminating the alert noise.
purpose_tldr: Stop false-positive cron-failure alerts by pinning Felix sub-agents to exec host=gateway.
